extracted.intended_audience: Readers of The New Yorker interested in entering or voting in the weekly Cartoon Caption Contest
extracted.subtask_short: New Yorker cartoon caption contest entry
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions and minimal rules for entering and participating in The New Yorker's weekly Cartoon Caption Contest: submit captions, finalists are selected, and readers vote; finalists and winners are published online and in the magazine.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission process (weekly)
rubrics_metrics.description: Each week, we provide a cartoon in need of a caption. You, the reader, submit your caption below, we choose three finalists, and you vote for your favorite.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This describes the core cycle: weekly cartoon -> reader submissions -> three finalists chosen by The New Yorker -> reader vote to pick a winner.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility (age requirement)
rubrics_metrics.description: Anyone age thirteen or older can enter or vote.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is the explicit eligibility rule on the page; fuller eligibility details may be in the complete rules (linked).

rubrics_metrics.name: Finalist selection
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selection of the three finalists is done by The New Yorker (implied). The page invites readers to help by rating submissions from the previous week.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public voting determines the winner
rubrics_metrics.description: You vote for your favorite caption.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: After finalists are posted, readers vote to select the winner. The site provides a 'Vote now' prompt and a mechanism to rate submissions to help pick finalists.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication of finalists and winners
rubrics_metrics.description: Finalists for this week’s cartoon... will appear online January 14th and in the January 21st, 2019, issue of The New Yorker.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Finalists and winners are published both online and in the print issue on specified dates; the page also shows past winners and their placement (winner, second place, third place) as examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complete rules reference
rubrics_metrics.description: To read the complete rules, click here.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page links to a separate full rules page; detailed legal/entry/formatting/prize terms are likely contained there rather than on this overview page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Community rating to assist finalist selection
rubrics_metrics.description: Help us pick three finalists from last week’s contest by rating submissions. Vote now »
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site solicits reader participation in rating prior entries to influence which captions become finalists.
